channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: Australian Dollar edges higher above 0.7200 on rising RBA hike bets, eyes on US NFP data
item.description: The AUD/USD pair gathers strength to near 0.7210 during the early European session on Friday. The US Dollar (USD) weakens against the Australian Dollar (AUD) following Federal Reserve (Fed) Governor Christopher Waller’s remarks.

item.title: Euro stalls above 1.1600 with Eurozone Retail Sales, US Nonfarm Payrolls on tap
item.description: The Euro (EUR) is trading flat above 1.1600 against the US Dollar (USD) on Friday, with upside attempts capped below the 1.1630 area.

item.title: Indonesian Rupiah declines as US Dollar gains despite easing Fed rate hike odds
item.description: USD/IDR gains ground after two days of losses, trading around 17,670 during the Asian hours on Friday. The currency pair is pushing higher as the US Dollar (USD) holds onto its recent gains after rebounding from intraday losses.

item.title: British Pound strengthens above 1.3500 as BoE stays hawkish, traders brace for US NFP data
item.description: The GBP/USD pair edges higher to around 1.3530 during the early European trading hours on Friday. Hawkish rhetoric from a Bank of England (BoE) policymaker provides some support to the British Pound (GBP) against the US Dollar (USD).

item.title: Gold bulls seem hesitant below $4,500 amid modest USD bounce ahead of US NFP
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) remains on the defensive below the $4,500 mark through the Asian session on Friday, snapping a two-day winning streak amid a modest US Dollar (USD) uptick.

item.title: Indian Rupee trades close to two-month low ahead of US NFP data
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) opens on a flat note against the US Dollar (USD) on Friday, but is close to its two-month high of 94.29 posted the previous day.

item.title: Japanese Yen retreats from August highs as USD bears turn cautious ahead of US NFP
item.description: The USD/JPY pair stages a modest intraday recovery from the vicinity of the August monthly low and climbs back to the 156.50 area during the Asian session on Friday. Spot prices, for now, seem to have snapped a two-day losing streak, though the upside potential seems limited.

item.title: Swiss Franc weakens ahead of Unemployment Rate data
item.description: USD/CHF gains ground after registering losses in the previous day, trading around 0.8080 during Asian hours on Friday.

item.title: WTI Price Forecast: Bulls await acceptance above $90.00 and 61.8% Fibo. amid Iran risks
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) – the benchmark US Crude Oil price – trades below the $90.00 mark during the Asian session on Friday and remains close to its highest level since July 24, touched earlier this week.

item.title: AUD/JPY Price Forecast: Rebounds above 112.50, while staying constrained below 100-day SMA
item.description: The AUD/JPY cross trades in positive territory near 112.80 during the early European trading hours on Friday. However, the potential upside for the cross might be limited as traders ramped up bets on a Bank of Japan (BoJ) interest rate hike, boosting the Japanese Yen (JPY).

item.title: India Gold price today: Gold falls, according to FXStreet data
item.description: Gold prices fell in India on Friday, according to data compiled by FXStreet.

item.title: EUR/JPY Price Forecast: Trades near 181.50 after rebounding from descending channel bottom
item.description: EUR/JPY gains ground after two days of losses, trading around 181.50 during the Asian hours on Friday. Technical analysis of the daily chart indicates the currency cross remains within the descending channel pattern, signalling a bearish bias.

item.title: EUR/USD Price Forecast: Strong recovery from 100-day MA ahead of US NFP data
item.description: The Euro (EUR) holds onto previous day’s gains at around 1.1630 against the US Dollar (USD) during the Asian trading session on Friday.

item.title: New Zealand Dollar gains momentum to near 0.5900, US NFP data looms
item.description: The NZD/USD pair gathers strength to near 0.5895 during the Asian trading hours on Friday. The US Dollar (USD) softens against the New Zealand Dollar (NZD) following Federal Reserve (Fed) Governor Christopher Waller’s remarks. Traders brace for the US August employment report later on Friday.

item.title: Japan’s Katayama says will closely monitoring bond markets with heightened urgency
item.description: Japanese Finance Minister (FM) Satsuki Katayama said on Friday that the officials will closely monitoring bond markets with heightened urgency.

item.title: United States Dollar Index weakens as Fed’s Waller signals rate pause
item.description: The US Dollar Index (DXY), which measures the value of the US Dollar (USD) against six major currencies, is losing ground for the third consecutive day and trading around 99.00 during Asian hours on Friday.

item.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD trades below $67.00 amid mixed setup as US NFP looms
item.description: Silver (XAG/USD) edges lower during the Asian session on Friday, snapping a two-day winning streak to the weekly high set the previous day.

item.title: Australian Dollar strengthens on RBA hike odds
item.description: AUD/USD extends its gains for the third successive day, trading around 0.7210 during the Asian hours on Friday.

item.title: Canadian Dollar remains on the front foot vs USD as US and Canada jobs data loom
item.description: The USD/CAD pair consolidates below the 1.3800 mark during the Asian session on Friday and remains close to a nearly two-week low, touched the previous day.

item.title: British Pound edges higher above 1.3500 ahead of US jobs report
item.description: The GBP/USD pair gathers strength to near 1.3530 during the early Asian trading hours on Friday. The British Pound (GBP) edges higher against the US Dollar (USD) following hawkish remarks from a Bank of England (BoE) policymaker.

item.title: WTI hovers around $89.50 as US military escorts tankers through Hormuz earlier this week
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) oil price moves little after registering losses in the previous day, trading around $89.50 per barrel during the Asian hours on Friday.

item.title: PBOC sets USD/CNY reference rate at 6.7787 vs. 6.7807 previous
item.description: On Friday, the People’s Bank of China (PBOC) sets the USD/CNY central rate for the trading session ahead at 6.7787 compared to the previous day's fix of 6.7807 and 6.7098 Reuters estimate.

item.title: Japanese Yen sits near August highs as USD remains on the back foot ahead of US NFP
item.description: The USD/JPY pair enters a bearish consolidation phase during the Asian session on Friday and currently trades near the 155.75 region, nearly unchanged for the day.

item.title: Euro steadies above 1.1600 as traders await US NFP data
item.description: The EUR/USD pair trades on a flat note around 1.1625 during the early Asian session on Friday. Traders prefer to wait on the sidelines ahead of the US key employment report for August, which will be published later on Friday.

item.title: RBNZ's Hansen: Future policy moves hinge on trends across broad economic data sets
item.description: Reserve Bank of New Zealand (RBNZ) Monetary Policy Committee member Carl Hansen said on Thursday that future monetary policy moves hinge on trends across broad economic data sets.

item.title: Gold rebounds above $4,450 as Waller tempers Fed rate hike bets ahead US jobs data
item.description: Gold price (XAU/USD) gains momentum to around $4,470 during the early Asian session on Friday. The precious metal extended its recovery as Federal Reserve (Fed) rate hike bets ease. All eyes will be on the US August Nonfarm Payrolls (NFP) report, which is due later on Friday.

item.title: GBP/JPY Price Forecast: Intervention shock exposes 210.00
item.description: The GBP/JPY tanks amid speculation of intervention by Japanese authorities in the FX markets, driven by a rate check by Tokyo. The cross-pair drops more than 300 pips, trades at 210.92, down by more than 1.40%.

item.title: The Australian Dollar thanks Waller's comments, which sink the USD
item.description: The Australian Dollar rises against the US Dollar on Thursday as Fed Governor Waller turns moderately dovish ahead of the September meeting, even as Oil prices rise due to a resumption of hostilities in the Middle East. The AUD/USD trades at 0.7200, up 0.44%.

item.title: New Zealand's Kiwi gets most of Wednesday back without earning it
item.description: The New Zealand Dollar trades just under 0.5900 into the New York afternoon, up roughly half a percent, after a session that retraced most of Wednesday's decision-day slide without a single New Zealand input.

item.title: Chinese Yuan: Underheld positions unwind with reflation risks – BNY
item.description: Geoff Yu at BNY highlights CNY as the main outlier in the U.S. trade-weighted basket, showing behavior opposite to other key currencies. CNY failed to react positively to July–August Fed and Treasury decisions, with weak domestic growth reinforcing easing expectations.
